title: Venture Capital as a Positive Power
primary_theme: Democratizing access to venture capital through data, education, and diversity
founder_lessons: Question pattern matching when it narrows who gets capital, talent, and opportunity.
Treat diversity as central to innovation because different backgrounds surface different problems and customer relationships.
Understand liquidity pressure because it affects LP commitments, new fund managers, and downstream founders.
Build durable ecosystem support for newer managers rather than relying on one-time momentum.
notable_quotes: Venture Forward is a nonprofit organization with the mission to democratize access to venture capital.
